report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94 ms durations; traces show healthy inventory, payment, and postgres spans; metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98 ms. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (500s, pool exhaustion, redis timeout, downstream latency, memory leak, bad config). Alert appears benign; no bounded fault can be established from current data.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error-rate baseline showing checkout degradation versus normal
Evidence of connection pool saturation or acquisition waits on order/postgres
Redis operation latency or timeout errors from inventory
Downstream payment latency measurements exceeding thresholds
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the alert window
